text: suffix-bench's measure (src/bin/measure.rs, run_sufr) runs vendor/sufr/<tool> -t N create -n P -m M -o <input>.sufr <input>. Since f085e43 sufr takes -t only after the subcommand and create has no -m, so a dev build needs a wrapper script in vendor/sufr that moves -t after create and drops -m 0. Checked 2026-11-13.
